bottleneck_analysis.primary_bottleneck: Readiness probe dependency fan-out (5 downstream probes per /ready call: Kafka, MLflow, Feast, Qdrant, vLLM)
bottleneck_analysis.gateway_edge_protection: Envoy Gateway token bucket rate limiter properly caps bursts at 10 rps (local_rate_limited 429)
bottleneck_analysis.recommendations: Cache probe results with 1-2s TTL for readiness endpoints under heavy external polling
